an3.36:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.36:1.4: so kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā, vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā, manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
an3.36:1.5: tamenaṃ bhikkhave nirayapālā nānābāhāsu gahetvā yamassa rañño dassenti:
an3.36:1.6: ‘ayaṃ deva puriso amatteyyo apetteyyo asāmañño abrahmañño, na kulejeṭṭhāpacāyī.
an3.36:2.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave yamo rājā paṭhamaṃ devadūtaṃ samanuyuñjati, samanugāhati, samanubhāsati:
an3.36:2.2: ‘ambho purisa, na tvaṃ addasa manussesu paṭhamaṃ devadūtaṃ pātubhūta’nti.
an3.36:3.2: ‘ambho purisa, na tvaṃ addasa manussesu itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā āsītikaṃ vā nāvutikaṃ vā vassasatikaṃ vā jātiyā, jiṇṇaṃ gopānasivaṅkaṃ bhoggaṃ daṇḍaparāyaṇaṃ pavedhamānaṃ gacchantaṃ āturaṃ gatayobbanaṃ khaṇḍadantaṃ palitakesaṃ vilūnaṃ khalitaṃsiro valitaṃ tilakāhatagatta’nti.
an3.36:4.2: ‘ambho purisa, tassa te viññussa sato mahallakassa na etadahosi:
an3.36:4.3: ‘ahampi khomhi jarādhammo jaraṃ anatīto, handāhaṃ kalyāṇaṃ karomi kāyena vācāya manasā’ti?
an3.36:5.2: ‘ambho purisa, pamādavatāya na kalyāṇamakāsi kāyena vācāya manasā.
an3.36:5.3: taggha tvaṃ ambho purisa, tathā karissanti yathā taṃ pamattaṃ.
an3.36:5.4: taṃ kho panetaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ neva mātarā kataṃ, na pitarā kataṃ, na bhātarā kataṃ, na bhaginiyā kataṃ, na mittāmaccehi kataṃ, na ñātisālohitehi kataṃ, na devatāhi kataṃ, na samaṇabrāhmaṇehi kataṃ.
an3.36:5.5: atha kho tayā vetaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ, tvaññevetassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedissasī’ti.
an3.36:6.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave yamo rājā paṭhamaṃ devadūtaṃ samanuyuñjitvā samanugāhitvā samanubhāsitvā, dutiyaṃ devadūtaṃ samanuyuñjati, samanugāhati, samanubhāsati:
an3.36:6.2: ‘ambho purisa, na tvaṃ addasa manussesu dutiyaṃ devadūtaṃ pātubhūtanti?’
an3.36:6.6: ‘ambho purisa, na tvaṃ addasa manussesu itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā ābādhikaṃ dukkhitaṃ bāḷhagilānaṃ, sake muttakarīse paḷipannaṃ semānaṃ aññehi vuṭṭhāpiyamānaṃ, aññehi saṃvesiyamānanti?’
an3.36:7.2: ambho purisa, tassa te viññussa sato mahallakassa na etadahosi:
an3.36:7.3: ahampi khomhi vyādhidhammo vyādhiṃ anatīto, handāhaṃ kalyāṇaṃ karomi kāyena vācāya manasāti.
an3.36:8.2: ‘ambho purisa, pamādavatāya na kalyāṇamakāsi kāyena vācāya manasā.
an3.36:8.3: taggha tvaṃ ambho purisa, tathā karissanti yathā taṃ pamattaṃ;
an3.36:8.4: taṃ kho panetaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ neva mātarā kataṃ, na pitarā kataṃ, na bhātarā kataṃ, na bhaginiyā kataṃ, na mittāmaccehi kataṃ, na ñātisālohitehi kataṃ, na devatāhi kataṃ, na samaṇabrāhmaṇehi kataṃ.
an3.36:8.5: atha kho tayā vetaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ. tvaññevetassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedissasī’ti.
an3.36:9.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave yamo rājā dutiyaṃ devadūtaṃ samanuyuñjitvā samanugāhitvā samanubhāsitvā, tatiyaṃ devadūtaṃ samanuyuñjati samanugāhati samanubhāsati:
an3.36:9.2: ‘ambho purisa, na tvaṃ addasa manussesu tatiyaṃ devadūtaṃ pātubhūtanti?’
an3.36:10.2: ‘ambho purisa, na tvaṃ addasa manussesu itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā ekāhamataṃ vā dvīhamataṃ vā tīhamataṃ vā uddhumātakaṃ vinīlakaṃ vipubbakajātanti?
an3.36:11.2: ‘ambho purisa, tassa te viññussa sato mahallakassa na etadahosi:
an3.36:11.3: ‘ahampi khomhi maraṇadhammo, maraṇaṃ anatīto, handāhaṃ kalyāṇaṃ karomi kāyena vācāya manasā’ti.
an3.36:12.2: ‘ambho purisa, pamādavatāya na kalyāṇamakāsi kāyena vācāya manasā.
an3.36:12.3: taggha tvaṃ ambho purisa, tathā karissanti yathā taṃ pamattaṃ.
an3.36:12.4: taṃ kho panetaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ neva mātarā kataṃ, na pitarā kataṃ, na bhātarā kataṃ, na bhaginiyā kataṃ, na mittāmaccehi kataṃ, na ñātisālohitehi kataṃ, na devatāhi kataṃ, na samaṇabrāhmaṇehi kataṃ.
an3.36:12.5: atha kho tayā vetaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ. tvaññevetassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedissasī’ti.
an3.36:13.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave yamo rājā tatiyaṃ devadūtaṃ samanuyuñjitvā samanugāhitvā samanubhāsitvā tuṇhī hoti.
an3.36:13.2: tamenaṃ bhikkhave nirayapālā pañcavidhabandhanaṃ nāma kāraṇaṃ karonti.
an3.36:13.3: tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ hatthe gamenti. tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ dutiyasmiṃ hatthe gamenti. tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ pāde gamenti. tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ dutiyasmiṃ pāde gamenti. tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ majjhe urasmiṃ gamenti.
an3.36:13.4: so tattha dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyati. na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti, yāva na taṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ byantī hoti.
an3.36:14.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave nirayapālā saṃvesetvā kuṭhārīhi tacchanti.
an3.36:14.2: so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vediyati, na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti, yāva na taṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ byantī hoti.
an3.36:15.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave nirayapālā uddhapādaṃ adhosiraṃ ṭhapetvā vāsīhi tacchanti …pe…
an3.36:15.2: tamenaṃ bhikkhave nirayapālā rathe yojetvā ādittāya bhūmiyā sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya sārentipi paccāsārentipi …pe…
an3.36:15.3: tamenaṃ bhikkhave nirayapālā mahantaṃ aṅgārapabbataṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ āropentipi oropentipi.
an3.36:15.4: tamenaṃ bhikkhave nirayapālā uddhapādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā tattāya lohakumbhiyā pakkhipanti, ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya.
an3.36:15.5: so tattha pheṇuddehakaṃ paccati. so tattha pheṇuddehakaṃ paccamāno sakimpi uddhaṃ gacchati, sakimpi adho gacchati, sakimpi tiriyaṃ gacchati.
an3.36:15.6: so tattha dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyati, na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti, yāva na taṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ byantī hoti.
an3.36:18.2: ‘ye kira bho, loke pāpakāni kammāni karonti, te evarūpā vividhā kammakāraṇā karīyanti.
an3.36:18.3: aho vatāhaṃ manussattaṃ labheyyaṃ, tathāgato ca loke uppajjeyya arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, taṃ cāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ payirupāseyyaṃ.
an3.36:18.4: so ca me bhagavā dhammaṃ deseyya, tassa cāhaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ ājāneyyanti.
an3.36:18.5: taṃ kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave na aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā sutvā evaṃ vadāmi. api ca kho bhikkhave yadeva me sāmaññātaṃ sāmaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sāmaṃ viditaṃ, tadevāhaṃ vadāmīti.
